international.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes to staff: ‘I made some terrible mistakes’
international.summary: Huang acknowledges he violated code of conduct by having affairs, but denied Trump was instrumental in his return Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff on Tuesday for the tumult he’s caused at the company. He acknowledged he violated the code of conduct for having extramarital affairs, but pushed back on the reports that Donald Trump was instrumental in his reinstatement as chief executive. “I made some terrible mistakes,” he said, according to a livestream reviewed by the New York Times . “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and, of course, I hurt all of you.” Continue reading...
